Rabi, Kharif and Zaid crops: when each is sown, harvested, and which crops grow. Class 10 Geography, explained.

• Rabi: sown in winter (October to December), harvested in summer (April to June)
• Kharif: sown with the monsoon, harvested in September and October
• Zaid: a short summer season between the two
• The board answer for rabi vs kharif, in two lines
